f3abe5dbea: CANTV posted a call for muralists and Cyd Smillie was selected. Her design was created based on interviews with board members and CANTV personnel. They requested a design which would be visible from the pink line train that runs along the east edge of the property. The design features the "bars and tones" seen on every monitor in the space awaiting content, with content reflecting the nearly 40 years of programming.
cc55a4358a: Southeast Chamber proudly partnered with Delilah Martinez of Vault Gallery to bring these 8 outstanding artists to our community for a one of a kind piece of art. This is the biggest collaborative mural on the southeast side.
